title: Law to study gambling habits and casino impacts
summary: This law would require the Health Department to study gambling behavior citywide, including among people aged 16 to 24, and how it relates to mental health, finances and domestic violence. It would also require the department to study how casino openings affect surrounding neighborhoods compared to similar areas without casinos, covering crime, education, economic development and housing affordability. The department would publish an annual report with findings and recommendations starting one year after the law takes effect.
